newsitem.title: PARAGUAY: SOCCER-PARAGUAY BEAT PERU TO SHARE LEAD IN SOUTH AMERICA.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-PARAGUAY BEAT PERU TO SHARE LEAD IN SOUTH AMERICA.

text.p: Paraguay, aiming to reach the World Cup finals for the first time since 1986, beat Peru 2-1 on Wednesday to go level on points with Colombia at the top of the South American qualifying group.
Aristides Rojas scored the winner two minutes before halftime after Peru had wiped out an early Paraguayan strike.
With the tournament reaching its halfway mark, Paraguay have the advantage of playing five of their remaining eight games at home in their intimidating "Defenders of the Chaco" stadium.
They have a 100 percent home record in the competition.

Defender Catalino Rivarola headed Paraguay ahead in the 12th minute but Jose Pereda hit back for Peru in the 33rd. Rojas' goal came in the 43rd minute after a quick exchange of passes between the Paraguayan midfield.

Peru are eighth in the nine-team group but are still only four points behind fourth-placed Ecuador, whom they play at home in their next match. The top four of the nine teams will qualify for the finals in France.

Paraguay - 1-Jose Luis Chilavert, 5-Celso Ayala, 4-Catalino Rivarola, 3-Carlos Gamarra, 2-Francisco Arce, 6-Estanislao Struway, 10-Roberto Acuna (8-Harles Bourdier, 72), 16-Julio Cesar Enciso, 15-Miguel Benitez, 20-Derlis Soto (9-Jose Cardozo, 81), 18-Aristides Rojas (11-Jorge Campos, 71).

Peru - 1-Julio Balerio, 3-Juan Reynoso, 5-Jose Soto (13- German Carty, 53), 7-Norberto Solano, 4-Percy Olivares, 8-Juan Jayo, 6-Roger Serrano, 20-Jose Pereda, 10-Roberto Palacios (18-Waldir Sens, 72), 11-Pablo Segarra (14-Jaime Magallanes, 67), 9-Flavio Maestri.
